original_title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Necron CGI Trailer Stomps All Over the Adeptus Mechanicus Trailer, but the Orks Trailer Is Still My Favorite

en.title: Necron Trailer for Dawn of War IV Unleashes Ancient Terror
en.summary: The latest CGI trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV showcases the formidable Necron faction, hinting at their ancient might. This cinematic preview builds anticipation for the game's upcoming release.
en.body:
The galaxy of **Warhammer 40,000** is vast and unforgiving, and the latest glimpse into **Dawn of War IV** reminds us just how ancient and terrifying its threats can be. Developer King Art Games has unleashed the CGI cinematic trailer for the Necron faction, and it’s a masterclass in building dread. This isn't about flashy explosions; it's about the palpable weight of 60 million years of slumber finally broken.

The trailer introduces us to Chronomancer Thothmek, a Necron lord awakened and decidedly displeased with the current state of affairs on the tomb world of Kronus. His pronouncements are not those of a conqueror eager for battle, but of a rightful owner reclaiming what was stolen. The visual presentation is striking, with the Necron command bridge exuding a chilling, alien aesthetic that perfectly captures their ancient, soulless nature. This trailer eschews direct combat for a powerful sense of impending doom, relying on atmosphere and the imposing presence of the xenos to convey their threat. The signature green-hued technology pulses with dark energy, promising a devastating force on the battlefield.

This Necron trailer marks the third in a series of narrative CGI previews for **Dawn of War IV**, following previous looks at the Adeptus Mechanicus and the Orks. While the Adeptus Mechanicus trailer was met with some disappointment, with the normally deadly Necrons portrayed as surprisingly inaccurate, this new offering rights that ship. It presents the Necrons as the imposing, ancient force they are renowned to be within the **Warhammer 40,000** lore. The contrast between the stoic, technologically advanced Necrons and the brutish, chaotic Orks, whose "CRASH FASTER!" trailer remains a fan favorite, highlights the diverse and brutal factions players will command or face.

## The Weight of Ages

The Necrons represent one of the oldest and most dangerous threats in the **Warhammer 40,000** universe. Their return in **Dawn of War IV** is a significant event for fans who appreciate the deep lore and the unique gameplay mechanics these immortal machines offer. The focus on atmosphere over action in their trailer is a deliberate choice that resonates with the faction's identity. It speaks to a cold, calculated inevitability rather than a frenzied assault. This approach allows players to truly feel the ancient menace and the sheer scale of their ambition to reclaim their lost empire. The visual design, from the intricate details of their tomb world to the menacing glow of their weaponry, creates an immersive experience that has fans buzzing with anticipation.

## What's Next for Dawn of War IV

With the Space Marines, Adeptus Mechanicus, Necrons, and Orks confirmed as the four launch factions, the only remaining piece of the narrative puzzle is the Space Marine CGI trailer. Given the **Dawn of War** series' storied history with iconic Space Marine cinematics, the pressure is undoubtedly on for this final reveal. **Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV** is slated for a PC release on September 17, 2026. Until then, fans will be dissecting every frame of these trailers, eager for more information about the strategic depth and narrative scope of this highly anticipated real-time strategy title.

content_raw: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV developer King Art Games has released the CGI cinematic trailer for the Necron faction, and it’s got aura written all over it. This latest trailer shows off the powerful Necron Chronomancer Thothmek, who, like most Necrons who wake after their 60 million year slumber, seems pretty grumpy at the state of the galaxy. Thothmek explains that he’s setting out to reclaim Kronus, which was a Necron Tomb World long before the Space Marines, Orks, and Adeptus Mechanics stepped foot on it. This is the third of King Art Games’ four in-game CGI narrative trailers for upcoming real-time strategy game Dawn of War IV, and while it perhaps doesn’t beat the wonderful Orks CGI trailer (“CRASH FASTER!”), for me it’s a step up from the disappointing Adeptus Mechanicus CGI trailer , which painted the normally deadly Necrons as worse shots than Star Wars Stormtroopers. This new trailer, though, makes the Necrons look as imposing and dreadful as they should. I particularly like the Necron bridge, which is dripping with Warhammer 40,000 cool as the xenos march to war. There’s no action here, and I love that. Rather, the Necrons are relying on vibes as they prepare for war. There’s a weight to their presence that helps get that across, I think. That, and plenty of green-hued alien tech you just know will be put to good use out on the battlefield. Dawn of War IV contains four factions at launch: Space Marines, Adeptus Mechanicus, Necrons, and Orks, which means all we’re waiting for now is the Space Marine CGI trailer. There’s a lot of pressure on that one, given the Dawn of War series’ history with iconic Space Marine CGI trailers . Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV launches on PC on September 17, 2026. While you wait, be sure to check out my interview with the developers at King Art Games to find out what to expect. Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100.
